t: 布韦特岛是世界最偏远的岛屿,由法国探险家让-巴蒂斯特·查尔斯·布韦德·洛齐耶所发现.
te: Bouvet Island, the world's remotest island, is discovered by French explorer Jean-Baptiste Charles Bouvet de Lozier.
dz: 布韦特岛是世界最偏远的岛屿,由法国探险家让-巴蒂斯特·查尔斯·布韦德·洛齐耶所发现.
de: Bouvet Island, the world's remotest island, is discovered by French explorer Jean-Baptiste Charles Bouvet de Lozier.

t: 瓦赛战役从马拉塔斯人进取入侵葡萄牙占领地开始.
te: The Battle of Vasai commences as the Marathas move to invade Portuguese-occupied territory.
dz: 瓦赛战役从马拉塔斯人进取入侵葡萄牙占领地开始.
de: The Battle of Vasai commences as the Marathas move to invade Portuguese-occupied territory.

t: 伊朗统治者纳德·沙阿的军队击败了印度莫卧儿皇帝穆罕默德·沙阿的军队.
te: The army of Iranian ruler Nader Shah defeats the forces of the Mughal emperor of India, Muhammad Shah.
dz: 卡纳尔战役:伊朗统治者纳德·沙阿的军队击败了印度莫卧儿皇帝穆罕默德·沙阿的军队.
de: Battle of Karnal: The army of Iranian ruler Nader Shah defeats the forces of the Mughal emperor of India, Muhammad Shah.

t: 纳德·沙阿在印度占领了德里并解雇了这座城市,偷走了孔雀王座的珠宝.
te: Nader Shah occupies Delhi in India and sacks the city, stealing the jewels of the Peacock Throne.
dz: 纳德·沙阿在印度占领了德里并解雇了这座城市,偷走了孔雀王座的珠宝.
de: Nader Shah occupies Delhi in India and sacks the city, stealing the jewels of the Peacock Throne.

t: 瓦赛战役以马拉塔斯人击败葡萄牙军队而告终.
te: The Battle of Vasai concludes as the Marathas defeat the Portuguese army.
dz: 瓦赛战役以马拉塔斯人击败葡萄牙军队而告终.
de: The Battle of Vasai concludes as the Marathas defeat the Portuguese army.

t: 斯托诺起义(英语:Stono Rebellion)是美国革命前英国本土北美殖民地最大的奴隶起义…
te: Stono Rebellion, the largest slave uprising in Britain's mainland North American colonies prior to the American Revolut…
dz: 斯托诺起义(英语:Stono Rebellion)是美国革命前英国本土北美殖民地最大的奴隶起义,爆发于南卡罗莱纳州查尔斯顿附近.
de: Stono Rebellion, the largest slave uprising in Britain's mainland North American colonies prior to the American Revolution, erupts near Charleston, South Carolina.

t: 贝尔格莱德条约签订后,奥地利将萨瓦河和多瑙河以南的土地割让给奥斯曼帝国.
te: The Treaty of Belgrade is signed, whereby Austria cedes lands south of the Sava and Danube rivers to the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 贝尔格莱德条约签订后,奥地利将萨瓦河和多瑙河以南的土地割让给奥斯曼帝国.
de: The Treaty of Belgrade is signed, whereby Austria cedes lands south of the Sava and Danube rivers to the Ottoman Empire.

t: 尼什条约由奥斯曼帝国和俄罗斯签署,结束俄-土耳其战争.
te: The Treaty of Niš is signed by the Ottoman Empire and Russia ending the Russian–Turkish War.
dz: 尼什条约由奥斯曼帝国和俄罗斯签署,结束俄-土耳其战争.
de: The Treaty of Niš is signed by the Ottoman Empire and Russia ending the Russian–Turkish War.

t: 詹金斯耳之战从第一次进攻拉瓜伊拉开始.
te: The War of Jenkins' Ear begins with the first attack on La Guaira.
dz: 詹金斯耳之战从第一次进攻拉瓜伊拉开始.
de: The War of Jenkins' Ear begins with the first attack on La Guaira.

t: 在詹金斯耳之战期间,英国和西班牙军队之间的波多贝略战役开始了.
te: Start of the Battle of Porto Bello between British and Spanish forces during the War of Jenkins' Ear.
dz: 在詹金斯耳之战期间,英国和西班牙军队之间的波多贝略战役开始了.
de: Start of the Battle of Porto Bello between British and Spanish forces during the War of Jenkins' Ear.
